note: Cron hardening. #[vespera::cron] jobs are evaluated in UTC (now documented); new optional tz = "Asia/Seoul" argument evaluates a job in an IANA time zone, behind the new opt-in cron-tz feature (chrono-tz; the name is checked at compile time and tz without the feature is a compile error). New overlap = "skip" argument skips and logs a tick while the previous run is still going (default stays "allow"). Every run is supervised: a panicking job is logged to stderr and its schedule continues. New vespera::cron::shutdown() and shutdown_and_wait(timeout) stop scheduling (process-wide, permanent) and wait for in-flight runs; Serve::serve_with_graceful_shutdown now calls both (no new runs once the signal resolves, in-flight runs get up to cron::DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_GRACE = 10 s after the server drained). CronJob gained with_name / with_timezone / with_overlap builders and cron::Overlap. JNI: jobs keep running on the shared JNI runtime and stop with shutdown0.
